transcript: If they don't include, you don't get involved. If they don't tell you, don't ask. If they don't invite you, don't go. Know your place in people's lives. This isn't pride, it's wisdom. When you chase someone who doesn't seek you, you're telling them your time is worth less than theirs. When you ask about what they didn't tell you, you're giving them permission to treat you as an option. When you go where you weren't invited, you're showing the world you don't know your own worth. In our monastery, I learned something that changed my life. The people who need to be there will be there without you chasing them. And those who leave will leave without you holding them back. My priorities, few contacts, private life, low profile, progress without showing off, live one day at a time. You don't need many friends, you need the right ones. You don't need everyone to know what you do. You need to do it in silence. You don't need applause, you need peace. How do you expect to fly if you don't distance yourself from those who pluck your feathers? There are people in your life who don't add to you. They take your energy, they take your time, they take your peace. And you stay there because you confuse habit with loyalty. The day you learn to let go of those who don't choose you, your life changes, keep your circle small, your life private and your profile low. What you protect in silence grows stronger. Write my peace in the comments if this reached you. But I want you to understand something. If it's hard for you to let go, if you keep going back to where they don't value you, if you can't stop looking for those who ignore you, it's not weakness, it's an inner void you've been trying to fill for years with others' approval. The emotional stress of living, worried about who includes you and who doesn't consumes you from within. It steals the peace you say you want. The day you fill that void from within, you stop needing anyone to choose you. And if you want to learn to build that inner peace that doesn't depend on anyone, I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
